notes: Important: Manual update required for this version - Please download the latest Setup and reinstall (or apply the update manually by extracting the portable/update zip to the app root). Your settings and playlists will be preserved. Future smaller updates can use the in-app updater again.
Native Playback - Albums play without embedding Bandcamp's page player. Faster startup, less RAM, and a smoother desktop feel.
Sign-In Only Browser - WebEngine opens only for Bandcamp login; wishlist, follow, and account state use lightweight HTTP with a secure Windows session file.
Silky Loading Spinner - Startup, URL loads, shutdown, and Settings theme Applying stay smooth while the main UI is busy.
Album Theme from Cover Art - Palette comes from the cover (Dark/Light adapt) because Bandcamp often blocks page-palette crawls; looks great in practice.
Design Refresh - Softer controls, clearer now-playing rows, refined progress knob, and album-theme chrome that follows your cover art.
Quality of Life - Jump lists center the current item, progress focus ring behaves for keyboard nav, and legacy webview-only Advanced options are hidden in native mode.
Thanks - Special thanks to everyone who tested and reported issues on the 4.1 line.
